name: completeness
description: complete=false for the first partial minute, a minute touched by a silence over 10 s, a minute whose quote volume rose with no print (tradeFeedMismatch), a minute with a bad-timestamp print, and minutes around a disconnect; late and replayed prints are counted, not applied.

cumulativeDelta.note: Unknown: not every minute since the session start (17:00 CT) is complete in live or recorded data.

coverage.note: Data starts when this server subscribed to the contract (on the first order-flow call for it); nothing before that exists unless the flow recorder wrote it.
